headline: North Georgia beats Columbus State and plays into December
dek: After losing to Columbus State in September and earlier in November, North Georgia beat its rival and won at Montevallo to remain the only conference side still playing. The program carries 71 goals, more than any other PBC side, against 27 conceded into its December match against Dallas Baptist.
displaced_by: North Georgia beat Columbus State and Montevallo to remain the only conference side still playing.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring has split the conference: North Georgia alone has more goals than Georgia College and Clayton State together, and only Columbus State comes near it.

wire.line: Grace McGill has sixteen goals and thirteen assists as North Georgia beats Columbus State and Montevallo to play on.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hollie Keefe has made 121 saves for Middle Georgia State, and 41 shots have still beaten her.

last_match.line: North Georgia extended its winning run after knocking off Columbus State, having already beaten Montevallo in September.

next_match.line: North Georgia is the only PBC side still playing and has not lost since its earlier defeat at Columbus State.
